# 1 Enoch Chapter 78 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 78 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 78:1-2 — The names of the sun and moon (Orjares, Tomas, Asonja, etc.)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | Preserved as-is from Ge'ez | These are proper names; transliteration only |
| LOGOS | Preserved as-is | Same |
| PNEUMA | Preserved as-is | All three agree; names are untranslatable |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three converge. The names are preserved in their Ge'ez transliteration. These enigmatic names (two for the sun, four for the moon) may reflect a lost liturgical or angelological tradition. No scholarly consensus exists on their derivation.

**Status:** Converged. Names preserved.

---

## 78:10 — Solar year as 365 days (vs. 364 elsewhere)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "three-hundred-and-sixty-five-days" | Literal; the Ge'ez MS reads 365 here |
| LOGOS | "three hundred and sixty-five days" | Same — follows the MS |
| PNEUMA | "three hundred and sixty-five days" | All three follow the MS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three translate the number as given in the MS (365). This is one of the notable internal tensions in the Astronomical Book: the calendar elsewhere insists on 364 days, but this verse gives 365 when calculating solar years in relation to lunar years. Most scholars attribute this to scribal variation or a different source. The number is rendered as given.

**Status:** Converged. Internal inconsistency noted but not harmonized.

---

## 78:7 — 'completes the month in eighteen portions and three tens and one part'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "eighteen-portions-and-three-tens-and-one-part" | Literal Ge'ez counting formula |
| LOGOS | "eighteen portions and three tens and one part" | Preserves the unusual enumeration |
| PNEUMA | "eighteen stages plus thirty-one parts" | Modern simplification of the same number |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. The unusual counting formula (18 + 30 + 1 = 49? or 18 + 31 = 49?) is preserved without harmonization. The Ge'ez counting method should be presented as the text has it.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Preserve the source enumeration.

---
